metadata.title: Implement Repository Layer
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Implement data access layer using Repository pattern with MongoDB. Use when creating or modifying data access components.

output.description: Repository interfaces, implementations, and MongoDB entity models

specificActions: Review Requirements: Understand entity and operations needed
Study Existing Patterns: Search for similar repositories in Data/Repositories/
Create/Update MongoDB Entity Model: Create entity class in Data/Entities/ (if new)
Create/Update Repository Interface: Define repository contract in Data/Repositories/Interfaces/
Implement Repository Class: Implement MongoDB operations in Data/Repositories/{category}/
Register in DI Container: Add repository registration
bestPractices: Search for similar repositories before creating
Review MongoDB entity patterns in Data/Entities/
Include async methods with CancellationToken support

substeps.name: Init-Step: Confirm Principles
substeps.description: Recall operating principles before starting this step
actions: Read `.processes/steps/_components/operating-principles.md` and recall all principles
Output: '✓ Principles confirmed for this step'

substeps.name: Review Requirements and Study Patterns
substeps.description: Understand entity structure and find existing patterns
actions: Understand entity structure and required operations
Search for similar repositories in Data/Repositories/
Review MongoDB entity patterns in Data/Entities/

substeps.name: Create/Update MongoDB Entity Model
substeps.description: Create entity class if new repository
actions: Create entity class in Data/Entities/
Map to MongoDB collection
Add appropriate attributes

substeps.name: Create/Update Repository Interface
actions: Create interface in Data/Repositories/Interfaces/
Define method signatures for required operations
Include async methods with CancellationToken support

substeps.name: Implement Repository Class
actions: Create implementation in Data/Repositories/{category}/
Inject MongoDB client/database
Implement each operation using MongoDB driver
Add error handling and logging

substeps.name: Register in Dependency Injection
actions: Add repository registration to DI container
Follow existing registration patterns

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
substeps.description: Verify principles were followed in this step
actions: Verify: Was log.json updated for any user interactions?
Verify: Were mandatory actions confirmed with output?
Output: '✓ Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Review requirements → Study patterns → (Create entity if new) → Create/update interface → Implement repository → Register in DI

fields: Information Produced: Repository created, operations implemented
Files Modified/Created: Entity model, interface, implementation
